Title: MCF7 treated with DMSO repeat 1
Characteristics: tissue: breast | cell line: MCF-7 | treatment: DMSO
Treatment: cells were treated with DMSO or romidepsin 50nM
Growth: T47D and MCF7 were treated with RPMI, DMEM/F12 medium, repectively, each supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS) and antibiotics in humidified atmosphere with 5% CO2 at 37C
Extraction: RNA was harvested using Total RNA Isolate Kit (NovelGene). 1 ug of total RNA was used for the construction of sequencing libraries | RNA libraries for RNA-seq were prepared using KAPA mRNA HyperPrep Kit (KAPA Biosystems, Roche, Basel, Switzerland) following manufacturer's protocols.
Processing: Sequence reads were trimmed for adaptor sequence/low-quality sequence using Trimmomatic | Trimmed sequence reads were mapped to H.  sapiens, GRCh38 using HISAT2 software (v 2.1.0) (parameters- default) | Read count extraction  were performed using FeatureCounts (v 2.0.0 ) | Normalization were performed using DEGseq (v 1.40.0) | Assembly: GRCh38 | Supplementary files format and content: tab-delimited text files includes raw counts for each sample
